action.objective: Commit Kg6, one of the two verified equal-best king moves, keeping the king central and active.
action.rationale: Kg6 and Kg8 both verified at depth 4 with exact -612 and identical score in the shared-depth comparison table (depth_limited=false). Kg6 avoids the corner, stays nearer the black king and central squares, while Kg8 would head to the edge where the rook can check more easily. Kg6's verification was complete: no mate-in-one, tactical refutation not_found, no checking-chain refutation. This is a lost rook endgame, so take the equally-scored move with better practical king position.
